_about: ASR correction table for the radiology profile. Radiology terminology only: every pair is a word a radiology lecture actually uses, and the wrong form on the left is one the local engines produce for it. Deliberately excluded: anything naming a person, a hospital or a department workflow, and anything from a private vault's own general-vocabulary table. Longer keys win, so a specific phrase is replaced before a shorter key can eat part of it.

_sections.radiology: Applied automatically. Only put a pair here when the wrong form is never a legitimate word in a radiology lecture.
_sections.context_sensitive: Never applied automatically. Listed so a human or an LLM can judge each occurrence.
